review_notes: Ramche landslide/road closure is in Melamchi, not claimed Helambu; July 23 accounts do not date this particular Ramche slope failure rather than the Friday-night flood.
Both Nagarik archive/video pages lack incident description, precise physical site, and day of failure; cannot establish a discrete June 11 Taplejung event.
Two empty Nagarik archive records concern ongoing slides and access to Langtang; neither identifies a discrete Kathmandu event or a defensible Aug 19 failure date.
Bimalnagar obstruction was partly cleared Sunday Sep 29, but Sep 30 reports only two-way reopening and do not specify whether slide began Sept 28 or Sept 29.
Lalitpur Bagmati-3 Takuche road-blocking slide is confirmed by Oct 4 report, but Oct 3 versus Oct 4 onset is not established from available reporting.
Bheriganga-2 home loss occurred in BS 2062 Shrawan (~2005) without an exact day; Jan 14 2021 is retrospective feature publication, not event date.
Basirang slide at Bopung, Jantedhunga is real but long-running over several years; the Sept 13 2023 feature supplies no exact occurrence date for a single new event.
Three outlets repeat an ongoing crack/small-slide report above Panchdhare Bazaar; initial failure day is unstated, so Aug 3 publication cannot anchor an exact event date.
Headline-only Taplejung archive page provides neither discrete incident site nor failure day; June 18 is publication date, not verified occurrence.
Makalu-3 Samatar dry slide blocked road for roughly a month before May 28 report, with repeated failures; exact onset day unavailable. Bhotkhola-4 is a flood-damaged bridge.
Makalu-3 New Basti road slide is documented by June 19 but obstruction already ongoing for two days; exact initial failure day is not supported for required date correction.
Kerabari Jaljala-7 landslide and road obstruction are real, but Oct 4 story describes ongoing failures after several days of rain without exact first failure date.
Source explicitly places July 26 slide on Kailash-Mansarovar road near Dharchula in Uttarakhand, India. Nepali victim and Baitadi official do not make it a Nepal event.
June 2 article describes clearing continuing daily Headbox/Siddhababa slides but cannot establish which discrete physical failure occurred specifically June 2.
